text: JSON precision. Preserve large integers and decimal numeric tokens when formatting data. Reject duplicate object keys and non finite numbers. Formatting must not change numeric values.
JSONL streaming. Each line contains one JSON record. Validate every line and report the invalid line number. An upstream generator can stop early even when received records are valid.

Retrieval augmented generation. Retrieve external documents and passages before generating an answer. Keep evidence sources and citation links. Retrieval ranking and answer factuality need separate evaluation.

Paper references. A DOI can resolve bibliographic metadata such as title authors and publication year. A citation key links a manuscript to its reference. Read the original paper before using an evidence claim.
Idempotent tasks. A task may execute again after a worker crash. Use an idempotency key to avoid repeated side effects. Retrying a failed task is not exactly once execution.

Data leakage. Split training validation and test data before model selection. Fit preprocessing on the training split. Keep held out test labels away from tuning and report limitations of a small dataset.
Server sent events. Persist ordered events with cursor ids. Deliver the final success failure or cancellation event before ending a stream. Reconnect with the last event id to replay missed events.

File integrity. Compare a downloaded file SHA256 digest with the published checksum. A digest checks content integrity but does not authenticate the author. Duplicate file candidates can also be compared byte by byte.
